card.name: Inside -toxicity words, before XICITY
card.fires_on: The piece just before "XIC" or "xicity" in words like neurotoxicity, nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity and hepatotoxicity. It is strongest in all-caps warning headings.

modes.label: Caps warning headings
modes.description: The ROTO or OTO piece inside capitalized toxicity terms in boxed warnings.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS INFUSION REACTIONS AND NEU<<ROTO>>XICITY

modes.label: Lowercase toxicity terms
modes.description: The piece before "xic" in lowercase or misspelled toxic-organ words in running text.
modes.example: the cadmium-metallothionein complex can be nephro<<to>>xic as it accumulates in the kidneys

card.writes: It pushes the model toward completing the word as toxic, toxicity or poison.
card.plain: It fires partway through words like neurotoxicity, just before the toxic ending is completed.
